OntologyVersionResolvingService.name: Extract from ontology annotations
OntologyVersionResolvingService.description: Versions the ontology based on ontology annotations.

form.title: Resolve ontology version and version IRI from ontology annotations
form.description:
OntoPuS will resolve the values for specified properties on each ontology release, it is the responsibility of the ontology author to change the values before releasing a new version. 
Select the annotation properties that will be used to determine the version and version IRI of the ontology.

version.title: Version predicate
version.description: The predicate that describes the version of the ontology. The value must be present in the ontology. The value must be a string.

versionIri.title: Version IRI predicate
versionIri.description: The predicate that describes the version IRI of the ontology. The value must be present in the ontology. The value must be an identifier.

GeneralVersioningService.title: User defined version
GeneralVersioningService.description: Manually enter the version of the ontology. Note that this will prevent auto-releasing new versions, since the user input will be required. When automatic release is triggered, the last version will be overwritten!
GeneralVersioningService.fields.version.title: Version

DateVersioningService.title: Date based version
DateVersioningService.description: Uses current date as the version (YYYY-MM-DD).

NonVersioningService.title: No versioning
NonVersioningService.description: The ontology will have a constant version `"latest"` that will not change with new releases. The version IRI will match the ontology IRI.

noPredicate.title: Missing predicate
noPredicate.detail: The predicate for {0} does not exist: <{1}>
